dedupe_keys.name: mobilitytwin pt opdtwin open source digital twin pipeline for public transport

description: MobilityTwin-PT is a development pipeline for building digital twins of public transport from open data and open source software. Buildings are taken from OpenStreetMap as GeoJSON, converted to CityGML and then to 3D Tiles; vehicle data come from GTFS static timetables and historical and live GTFS Realtime feeds; public transport and private vehicles are co-simulated in SUMO for noise, emission and congestion scenarios; and results are shown in a CesiumJS web viewer using time-dynamic CZML, served by Node.js and Express for simulation output and Flask with MongoDB for real-time GTFS data. It was developed by the Mobility Informatics Lab at KTH Royal Institute of Technology and described by Jostmann, Mo, Wang and Ma in the Journal of Public Transportation (volume 28, article 100149, 2026, open access). The demonstration covers the Kista district of Stockholm with regional GTFS data from the Swedish KoDa API, and the pipeline is location independent. Code and documentation are free on GitHub. Licence: not stated for the resource; the describing article (doi:10; reuse terms therefore remain unverified.1016/j.jpubtr.2026.100149) is CC-BY-4.0. The platform supports digital twin, network flow and agent-based studies, from retrospective delay analysis to scenario testing of emissions and congestion, and builds on the SUMO and GTFS records catalogued here.
